projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for context-matching focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story. Generated 11 stories (US-75-002 through US-75-012) targeting context-matching wire-up gaps. Key finding: MatchScoring.apply_all_adjustments() has title_relevance, description_relevance, tag_keyword_boost, chapter_topic_match, chapter_source_consistency, chapter_coherence_penalty, cross_chapter_relevance, and listicle_consistency adjustments, but TieredMatcher only calls basic adjustments (topic_penalty, broll_boost, caption_quality, timing_penalty, project_boost, consecutive_source_penalty). The advanced adjustments are orphaned code.

userStories.title: Wire tag_keyword_boost adjustment into TieredMatcher scoring pipeline
userStories.notes: Tier: CRITICAL WIRE-UP. userStories.title: Wire chapter_topic_match and chapter_source_consistency into TieredMatcher
userStories.notes: Tier: CRITICAL WIRE-UP. Both apply_chapter_topic_match (~line 2436) and apply_chapter_source_consistency (~line 2538) exist in MatchScoring but are only reachable through apply_all_adjustments, which is never called from TieredMatcher. The chapter infrastructure (chapter_index on segments, chapter_title in text_metadata, chapter_grouping config) is all in place. Need to wire these into the TieredMatcher scoring block, passing current_chapter_index, chapter_title, recent_matches, and chapter_source_counts. Files: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (~line 730-780), src/matching/scoring.py (~lines 2436, 2538).

userStories.title: Wire chapter_coherence_penalty and cross_chapter_relevance into TieredMatcher
userStories.notes: Tier: WIRE-UP. apply_chapter_coherence_penalty (~line 2608) penalizes using >5 different video chapters in a single voiceover section. apply_cross_chapter_relevance_boost (~line 2664) uses the relevance_matrix to boost candidates from relevant chapters. Both exist in MatchScoring.apply_all_adjustments but are unreachable from TieredMatcher. The relevance_matrix is already computed in main.py (~line 256) but only passed to embedding_search, not to TieredMatcher for scoring. Files: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py, src/matching/main.py (~line 256-262, ~288), src/matching/scoring.py (~lines 2608, 2664).
acceptanceCriteria: TieredMatcher receives relevance_matrix (passed from match_all_segments)
chapter_coherence_penalty fires when >5 unique video chapters used in a voiceover chapter
cross_chapter_relevance boost is applied when relevance_matrix entry is high for the candidate's chapter
Both adjustments appear in confidence_breakdown with descriptive reasons
Unit test: voiceover chapter with 6+ different video sources gets coherence penalty
Unit test: candidate from high-relevance video chapter gets cross_chapter_relevance boost

userStories.title: Wire listicle_consistency adjustment into TieredMatcher scoring pipeline

userStories.title: Add MatchScoring.apply_all_adjustments integration test with full pipeline
userStories.notes: Tier: TESTING. Once US-75-002 through US-75-007 wire up individual adjustments, we need an integration test that verifies the complete adjustment chain works end-to-end through TieredMatcher. The test should create a realistic matching scenario with chapters, video metadata, tags, and listicle groups to verify all adjustments fire correctly. This also serves as a regression guard to ensure future refactors don't disconnect adjustments again. Files: tests/test_matching_scoring.py or new tests/test_tiered_matcher_adjustments.py, src/matching/tiered_matcher.py, src/matching/scoring.py.

Test verifies chapter_topic_match and chapter_source_consistency appear when chapters are active
Test verifies the final confidence is different from the base embedding similarity
All adjustment values are within documented ranges (no unbounded boosts)

userStories.title: Build video_id-to-metadata lookup for efficient context access during matching
userStories.notes: Tier: INFRASTRUCTURE. Multiple stories (US-75-002 through US-75-007) need to resolve video_title, video_description, and video_tags from a video_id during scoring. Currently video_metadata is a Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] with only title and description. This story extends it to include tags and chapters, and builds the lookup once in the match stage (src/stages/match.py) from caption_results and video_search_results. Files: src/stages/match.py (where match_all_segments is called), src/matching/main.py (match_all_segments signature ~line 32), src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (self.video_metadata usage).
acceptanceCriteria: video_metadata dict includes 'tags' key (List[str]) for each video_id
video_metadata dict includes 'chapters' key (List[dict]) for each video_id
Lookup is built once in match stage from caption_results before calling match_all_segments
Missing metadata fields default to empty (empty string, empty list) - never None
Unit test: video_metadata built from mock caption_results contains title, description, tags, chapters
Unit test: video with no caption_result still gets empty-string defaults in metadata

userStories.title: Propagate chapter and listicle state from detection to match stage
userStories.notes: Tier: INFRASTRUCTURE. Chapter detection runs in caption_stage and produces chapter data. Listicle detection also runs there. The results need to flow into match_all_segments so TieredMatcher can use them for chapter_topic_match, chapter_source_consistency, chapter_coherence, and listicle_consistency. Currently match stage receives location_chapters but not the full chapter/listicle context needed for scoring. Files: src/stages/match.py (run method - where match_all_segments is called), src/stages/caption_stage.py (where chapters are detected), src/matching/main.py (match_all_segments signature), src/checkpoint.py (chapter data in checkpoint).

userStories.title: Add description keywords to embedding text for enriched semantic search
userStories.notes: Tier: ENHANCEMENT. Currently embedding_text includes [title] and optionally [title | chapter] prefix, but video description keywords are not included. For videos with rich descriptions (common for educational/documentary content), adding top 3-5 description keywords to embedding text could improve semantic matching. This should be gated behind a config flag since it changes embedding dimensions/cache. Files: src/stages/caption_stage.py (_populate_text_metadata ~line where embedding_text is built), src/config/sections/matching.py (ContextEnrichmentConfig - add description_enriched_embeddings flag).
acceptanceCriteria: New config flag matching.context_enrichment.description_enriched_embeddings (default: false)
When enabled, top 3-5 content keywords from video description are appended to embedding_text
Keywords are extracted using simple word frequency (no LLM call needed)
Stop words and YouTube-specific words (subscribe, like, video, channel) are filtered out
Unit test: embedding_text includes description keywords when flag is true
Unit test: embedding_text is unchanged when flag is false (backward compat)

userStories.title: Add gap-specific description-derived queries to iterative match
userStories.notes: Tier: ENHANCEMENT. derive_queries_from_descriptions exists in gap_analyzer.py (~line 927) and is called from iterative_match stage (~line 868), but the current call passes all locked match descriptions as broad queries (priority=1, gap_indices=[]). The function supports gap-specific targeting (scores phrases by relevance to gap text) but the stage doesn't use per-gap description queries. Should call derive_queries_from_descriptions per gap segment for targeted queries. Files: src/stages/iterative_match.py (~line 867-889), src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py (derive_queries_from_descriptions ~line 927).
acceptanceCriteria: For each gap segment, derive_queries_from_descriptions is called with that gap's context
Gap-specific description queries have higher priority (2) than broad description queries (1)
Gap-specific queries include gap_indices pointing to the specific gap segment
Broad description queries are still generated as fallback
Unit test: gap-specific query generation returns queries relevant to gap text
Unit test: queries include correct gap_indices and elevated priority
